knownLandmarkOwnership.impact: Nested/duplicate main landmarks can confuse landmark navigation. They reproduce on the overview, including loading and pagination states.
knownLandmarkOwnership.gate: Moderate findings remain visible to SA review. The runner forbids serious/critical findings; these do not meet that blocking severity. No rule was disabled.

scope: Payouts workspace at each materially distinct state; denied/redirected route main when workspace does not mount. Real Settings destination inspected for routing and controls, not claimed as a full Settings accessibility audit.
